narr: Rain showers produced heavy rain of 3 to 5 inches across the warned area. This led to flash flooding in Johnson county and Muscatine County.
ev: A HAM radio operator reported multiple cars stalled in standing water near the Stewart Road and Dick Drake Way intersection. Mississippi River Drive in the downtown area was also flooded.
Rapid Creek at Wilson's Orchard came out of its banks, overspreading an area the size of a football field with 2 to 3 feet of fast flowing water. Access to the south side of the orchard was cut off.
